title: Three Years and One Short Tool
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：wage　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wage 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the craftsman ① earned the wage that no apprentice in the workshop would have recorded, and he said the earning was the whole of the year. The ② wage, meaning the pay itself and not the tool, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a wage, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ wage in that workshop had the same short tool beside it, and the ④ wage at the far bench, meaning the order they kept for the children to finish and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A wage, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the craftsman said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the wage was the whole of the matter, meaning the livelihood and not the pay. The ⑥ wage, meaning the livelihood and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; wage, he said, is either something you earn or the only word that means both a pay and a livelihood. He said the livelihood is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ wage had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short tool. The ⑧ wage of the whole thing, the craftsman wrote in August, was one workshop and three years of recording; wage, he said, is either the order at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ wage I remember is the pay recorded in the ledger, which closed in 1983 and is still recorded as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ wage, my mother said in 1985, is the only pay that improves by being recorded; every wage, she said, is a livelihood that has agreed to look like a pay. She said the livelihood was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 工资（指工坊里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 工资（指那份工资本身，与小小的工具相对）
C. 固定搭配：earn the wage 挣这一份工资
D. n. 工资（指留给孩子们赶完的那一桩）
E. n. 工资之事（抽象总称，指一处工坊的工资之事）
F. n. 工资（指工料簿里写到、被记载的那一份）
G. n. 工资、养家（指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 养家（抽象总称，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: earned the wage that no apprentice in the workshop would have recorded
The wage, meaning the pay itself and not the tool
the wage at the far bench
the wage was the whole of the matter

answers.why: earn the wage 意为“挣这一份工资”，1976 年那位匠人把工坊里没有一位学徒肯记载的一份工资做了一遍。
wage 意为“工资”，指那份工资本身而不是小小的工具，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
wage 意为“工资”，指工坊里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一件小小的工具。
wage 意为“工资”，指最远那张案台的留给孩子们赶完的那一桩，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
wage 意为“工资、养家”，指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份养家就是那件事的全部。
wage 意为“养家”，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份工资，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
wage 意为“工资”，指工料簿里写到、被记载的那一份，到 1981 年这一份成了工料簿里的一行。
wage 意为“工资之事”，匠人八月写道，整件事的工资之事是一处工坊和三个年头的记载。
wage 意为“工资”，我记得的是工料簿里记载过的那一份，1983 年出师了，至今仍被说成工坊里最安静的一份。
wage 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，工资是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的工资。
